import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react'; import { getAuthToken } from '../services/authStorage'; const initialForm = { agent_name: '', agent_number: '', store_number: '', business_owner_name: '', contact_phone: '', id_number: '', business_location: '', date_visited: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), registration_date: '', admin_name: '', witness_name: '', witness_id_number: '', witness_phone: '', customer_type: '', outcome: '', visit_mode: 'field_visit', heard_about_okoa: '', interested_in_okoa: '', already_uses_okoa: '', new_client: true, customers_visited: '', registered_count: '', appointment_count: '', undecided_count: '', not_interested_count: '', referral_count: '', notes: '', commission_statement: 'false', kra_pin: 'false', national_id: 'false', business_permit: 'false', contract: 'false', }; const documentFields = [ ['commission_statement', 'Commission statement'], ['kra_pin', 'KRA PIN'], ['national_id', 'Copy of national ID'], ['business_permit', 'Business permit'], ['contract', 'Contract between agent & sub-agent'], ]; export default function SalesDailyReportForm({ onSubmitted }) { const [form, setForm] = useState(initialForm); const [documents, setDocuments] = useState([]); const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false); const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null); const summaryText = useMemo(() => { const lines = [ `Area/region visited: ${form.business_location || 'Not stated'}`, `Customers visited: ${form.customers_visited || '0'}`, `New client: ${form.new_client ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`, `Heard about Okoa Float: ${form.heard_about_okoa || 'Not stated'}`, `Interested in using Okoa Float: ${form.interested_in_okoa || 'Not stated'}`, `Already using Okoa Float: ${form.already_uses_okoa || 'Not stated'}`, `Registered: ${form.registered_count || '0'}`, `Appointments: ${form.appointment_count || '0'}`, `Undecided: ${form.undecided_count || '0'}`, `Not interested: ${form.not_interested_count || '0'}`, `Referrals: ${form.referral_count || '0'}`, `Customer feedback: ${form.notes || 'None provided'}`, ]; return lines.join(' | '); }, [form]); const update = (name, value) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value })); const toggleDocument = (name) => { setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: current[name] === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true', })); }; const handleFiles = (event) => { setDocuments(Array.from(event.target.files || [])); }; const submit = async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); setSubmitting(true); setFeedback(null); try { const body = new FormData(); Object.entries(form).forEach(([name, value]) => body.append(name, value)); body.set('notes', summaryText); documents.forEach((file) => body.append('documents', file)); const response = await fetch('/api/sales/reports', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${getAuthToken()}` }, body, }); const payload = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(payload.error?.message || 'Unable to submit daily report.'); } setForm({ ...initialForm, date_visited: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) }); setDocuments([]); setFeedback({ type: 'success', text: payload.message || 'Daily sales report submitted.' }); if (onSubmitted) onSubmitted(payload.data); } catch (error) { setFeedback({ type: 'error', text: error.message }); } finally { setSubmitting(false); } }; return (

SALES AND MARKETING

Daily sales report

Track field visits, customer feedback, registrations, appointments, and referrals.

{feedback && (
{feedback.text}
)}
Documents submitted
{documentFields.map(([name, label]) => ( ))}
